name: dimension_prints_its_value
why: REPORT 8CD843, ROUND 21, POINT 4 (P1, 28/10/2026). On the real drawings of 26P000009 and 26P000011 an edge of 0.75 mm was printed «0,8», 1.835 «1,8», 3.535 «3,5» and 10.018 «10» (args21 009_V1, 009_V5): the template gives one decimal, and the answer said the right value in «mm» beside the wrong number in «text_shown» without a word. Now a dimension placed gets the decimals its value needs, «decimals» fixes them, and a dimension that still prints another number is listed in «rounded_on_the_sheet».
defect_caught: A dimension that prints a rounded number (80.125 printed «80,1» or «80,13») answered as placed; «decimals» asked and not applied, or applied without saying the dimension it rounds; a «decimals» that cannot be used taken anyway.
_why_these_numbers: 80.125 needs three decimals, more than a template gives: the top view (V2) shows it beside 120. 10.25 needs two: with «decimals» 0 the front view (V1) prints it «10», and that is said.

expect.tolerance_why: 120 x 80.125 x 10.25, computed: the plate whose numbers need decimals

expect.why: a drawing is made on a saved part
the drawing is the active document
the views the dimensions go on
the width and the length of the plate, read back from the model
THE NUMBER ON THE SHEET IS THE VALUE: 80.125 printed with the three decimals it needs, whatever the template gives
no «decimals» asked: each dimension gets the ones its value needs
the thickness, read back from the model
WHAT «decimals» ROUNDS IS SAID: with no decimal 10.25 prints «10», and the answer says it instead of leaving it to the drawing
